_doc: The music decision, recorded here because PRODUCTION_ORDERS §2 requires it and because it OVERRIDES the installed graph. data/music.json says "provider": "none" and is frozen; it is never edited. This file is where the override lives, and it is the only thing that licenses the studio to run a music provider at all.
chosen: Generated. ElevenLabs music, or another generative provider if better.

overrides.why_the_graph_is_not_edited: v1.0.6 is frozen and byte-identical to the package. A decision that reverses one of its fields belongs in direction/, where it can be read beside its reason, not written into the source of truth.

what_does_not_change: data/music.json's BRIEF is still the brief. The ensemble, the four descending notes, the theme resolving once in the product under M6/13-14, and the silences - no music at all in M1 and M5, nothing under the name Ravana in M4, nothing under the refusal in M3 - are all still binding. Only who plays it has changed.

The theme remains OURS and is declared as ours. A generated theme is class S exactly as a composed one would be: the source establishes no music, and nothing in any payload, export or caption may present it as traditional or as the text's.
Nothing generated is presented as performed by a named musician or in a named gharana.
note: This reverses a choice the studio previously stated as deliberate - CLAUDE.md says MUSIC_PROVIDER=none is deliberate and that no API writes the theme. That line is now out of date and says so.
